text:
liz: Hey folks — I started today and I'm trying to confirm the orientation sessions tomorrow. My calendar shows 10:00 but I'm in CET and it looks like 19:00 which feels late. Also where will recordings be posted? Thanks! :wave:

alex_peopleops: Welcome, Liz! Quick schedule recap: Mon 10:00 PT — company overview & intro; Tue 09:00 PT — product + infra; Thu 11:00 PT — benefits/HR. Event title is "Redwood New Hire Orientation — Week 1". Zoom links are attached in each calendar event and recordings are uploaded to Google Drive > Onboarding/Recordings and linked in the event notes. Master recordings folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OnboardRec (access: redwood.com accounts). If your calendar conversion looks wrong, open the event and check the time zone setting.

marta_eng: If you're on CET, Mon 10:00 PT = Mon 19:00 CET. I usually add a local-time line in the event description like: "10:00 PT / 19:00 CET". If auto-conversion fails, import this .ics into your calendar: https://redwood.tools/onsite/week1.ics (works with Google/Apple/Outlook).

kevin_it: Zoom passcode is in the calendar invite. If you can't join via the desktop client, try the web client: https://zoom.us/wc/join/1234567890. Recording processing can take ~30–45 mins after the meeting; we also auto-generate transcripts (.vtt) and publish PDFs to the same Drive folder. If you can't access the Drive folder, ping me and I'll add your redwood.com account.

liz: Thanks — one more Q: the Mon 19:00 CET time conflicts with another commitment. Is there a catch-up or should I just watch the recording and schedule a 1:1? :pray:

alex_peopleops: We run an optional "new hires drop-in" on Fridays 10:00 PT (not ideal for CET folks sometimes). We can schedule a 30m 1:1 with your People Ops buddy or place you in next week's live cohort. @marta_eng is your assigned onboarding buddy — she can offer a 1:1.

marta_eng: Happy to do a 30m 1:1 Tue 16:00 CET (Tue 07:00 PT) — LMK if that works and I'll send an invite with local times included. I can run the slides + repo access and the quick checklist (email, Slack, repo).

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Orientation event added to your calendar by People Ops. Save the Zoom link and check pre-reads in Confluence at https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD. [auto-note]

liz: Tue 16:00 CET works for me. Where are pre-reads? Also my internet will be flaky — are recordings downloadable, and do we have transcripts?

alex_peopleops: Pre-reads live in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/Week+1. PDFs and slide deck are downloadable for offline viewing. Zoom cloud player sometimes supports 1.5x/2x playback; if not, download the .mp4 and use VLC. We also publish transcripts and a short TL;DR doc in the Drive recordings folder.

marta_eng: I added the 1:1 to the calendar and included both PT and CET times in the description. Quick tip: in Google Calendar, open the event > More actions > Change time zone to see or edit the event timezones.

kevin_it: If anyone hits SSO/zoom access issues, use the "Guest join" link in the invite and enter the passcode. If SSO blocks you, ping #help with subject "zoom access" and I'll escalate immediately.

liz: Awesome — thank you all! :heart:
